notices: Removed WANOPT, NETSCAN, FEXP features from USB-A
FortiGate-92D High Availability in Interface Mode
Use of dedicated management interfaces (mgmt1 and mgmt2)

observations.description: After upgrade, the chassis doesn't identify FIM/FPMs in the GUI, FMG tunnel down.
Spamfilter does not leave Anti-Spam log for the exempted traffic by bwl matching.
Traffic may not be able to go through the NPU VDOM link with traffic shaper enabled on FG-3810D TP mode.
FG-3815D does not support 1GE SFP transceivers.
The UTM log may incorrectly report a file that has been sent to FortiSandbox. FortiView > FortiSandbox may still show files are submitted even after the daily upload quota has been reached.
Local-category status display may not change after running unset category-over-ride in the CLI.
Adding an override application signature may cause all category settings to be lost.
All sessions: filter application, threat, and threat type may not work as expected.
When creating an id_based policy with SSL enabled, and the set gui-multipleutm disable is applied, an Entry not found error message may appear.
Explicit policy may be automatically reset to log security events.
When navigating FortiView > Application some security action filters may not work.
Users may not be able to create new address objects from the Firewall Policy.
LDAP browser in LDAP-group-GUI may not respect group filter from LDAP server.
On NP4 platforms, TCP traffic may not be able to be offloaded in the decryption direction.
Adding more than eight members to LACP get np6_lacp_add_slave may result in an error.
Medium type may be shown incorrectly on shared ports.
GUI should not allow read-only admin to back up configuration.
SIP calls may be denied when using a combination of SIP ALG, IPS, and AppCtrl.
If the requested URL has port number, the URL filter may not block properly.
YouTube header injection (replacement for YouTube for Schools) was deleted.
Webfilter static URL filter blocks additional domains with similar names.
If the client is connecting to an SSID with WPA-Enterprise and User-group, it may not be able to pass the traffic policy.
SSID may stop broadcasting.
